description: MainActivity.kt is the main activity source file for a Tic-Tac-Toe Android application. It manages the game state, user interactions, UI updates, and game logic such as checking for a winner or a draw.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Primary activity class that handles the UI and game logic for a Tic-Tac-Toe game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI references, and starts a new game.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user taps on a cell, updates the game state, and determines game outcome.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets game state and UI to start a new game.

methods.name: renderBoard
methods.description: Updates the UI to reflect the current game board.

methods.name: setBoardEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables interaction with the game cells.

methods.name: setStatusWinner
methods.description: Displays the winner of the game.

methods.name: getColorCompat
methods.description: Retrieves a color resource in a compatible way.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Checks if the game is a draw.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Determines if there is a winner based on the current board.
